description: Additional classical baselines for the SRSR grid: the paper baseline and ideal-quantum reservoirs (in-run anchors) and the tuned ESN, each with a linear ridge and an RBF kernel ridge; 8 configurations, full-size kernels. Independent controls, not the paper's method.

experiment._comment_reservoir_types: classical = ReservoirPy defaults (paper baseline); quantum_ideal = ideal quantum reservoir; esn_tuned = the same ReservoirPy reservoir with spectral radius, leak rate and input scaling tuned on the eval split (12 settings).
